'''Taggart''' was the name of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who specialized in moving [[Glitterstim/Legends|Glitterstim]] spice throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he arranged to meet with fellow smuggler, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], at a spaceport in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He wanted to move some of his product through Han and avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] detection. Solo however, was forced to change his plans at the last minute when an aging [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] offered him 17,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to transport him to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
